title: A semantic layer records how the business uses its language
text: The supplied note connects reusable expertise with shared entities, synonyms, regional context and policy meaning. A semantic layer is therefore more than a dictionary: it should explain which interpretation applies in a particular business setting.
qualification: Conceptual/practitioner guidance; no claim that a particular database or vendor product supplies this automatically.
